target.table_description: Foundation Data Product - loan agreement entity-state table with SCD2 history loaded via MERGE

columns.name: loan_agreement_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the loan agreement

code.content: MERGE INTO fdp_uk_lending_db.loan_agreement AS tgt USING ( SELECT s.agreement_id, CAST(s.loan_amt AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS loan_amount, CASE WHEN s.rate_type_cd = 'F' THEN 'FIXED' WHEN s.rate_type_cd = 'V' THEN 'VARIABLE' WHEN s.rate_type_cd = 'T' THEN 'TRACKER' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS interest_rate_type, CAST(TO_DATE(CAST(s.row_last_modified_dt AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS DATE) AS eff_start_date FROM e_core_db.lending_agreement s ) AS src ON tgt.loan_agreement_id = src.agreement_id AND tgt.active = '1' WHEN MATCHED AND ( tgt.loan_amount <> src.loan_amount OR tgt.interest_rate_type <> src.interest_rate_type ) THEN UPDATE SET tgt.eff_end_date = src.eff_start_date, tgt.active = '0', tgt.dw_upd_lod_tmp = current_timestamp() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( loan_agreement_id, loan_amount, interest_rate_type, eff_start_date, eff_end_date, active, dw_lod_tmp, dw_upd_lod_tmp ) VALUES ( src.agreement_id, src.loan_amount, src.interest_rate_type, src.eff_start_date, CAST('3499-12-31' AS DATE), '1', current_timestamp(), current_timestamp() )

when_matched.description: Close the current active record by end-dating it when source values have changed

when_not_matched.description: Insert new record with current effective date and high-end date for SCD2 open record
